Hi Alyssa,

Thanks again for the demo earlier — the SurgiTech team looked ready to run a short POC. To keep momentum we sketched a short mutual action plan (MAP) focused on getting a production-like staging environment so you can validate latency, cost, and routing. High level asks we need from your side to kick off the POC provisioning: 

- Org setup: please invite marcus_lin@redwood.com and neha_kapoor@redwood.com as org admins on your Redwood trial tenant (or tell us the admin email and we’ll submit the invite).
- API keys: designate a staging key scope (read/write vs read-only) and let us know whether you prefer ephemeral keys or a long-lived key for the 2-week POC.
- IP allowlist: we need the SurgiTech staging IP CIDRs to add to our outbound allowlist; attached is a safelist template you can fill (safelist_template.csv).
- VPC peering: if you want dedicated throughput / low-latency routing we can stand up VPC peering — please share the cloud account ID and the primary network contact.

Proposed MAP milestones (attached as map_timeline.xlsx):
- Day 0–2: org + API key exchange, allowlist populated
- Day 3–5: environment provisioning and sanity checks (sample prompts, throughput test)
- Day 6–10: workload simulation and latency/cost measurement
- Day 11–14: wrap-up, mutual acceptance criteria and next steps (SLA/contract conversations)

Small asks for this week so we don’t block infra: 1) can you confirm the staging network contact and 2) attach a filled safelist row for the first CIDR? If you prefer, Neha is happy to run a short call with your network team.

Attachments: map_timeline.xlsx (spreadsheet), safelist_template.csv (CSV)

Thanks,

Hi Alyssa / netops,

Great — thanks for the quick reply and the initial CIDR. A few security/compliance notes to speed reviews: 

- Ephemeral keys: yes, Redwood supports short-lived API keys with programmatic rotation. For the POC we typically issue a scoped key with 24h TTL and provide a small helper script to refresh. I attached a safelist_template.csv to show the columns we need (label, CIDR, environment, start/end).
- Preflight runbook: below is a concise checklist you can paste into your ticket system: 
  1) Confirm accounts + accept org invites (done)
  2) Populate safelist_template.csv with staging CIDRs (we added 10.41.128.0/24)
  3) Decide on peering (optional for initial test — required only if you need <15ms RTT consistently)
  4) Exchange ephemeral key handshake script location + test key rotation
  5) Run 1k sample tokens per minute test for 30 minutes, report latency p50/p95

- Auditing: we'll enable call-level logs scoped to the POC tenant; if you need longer retention please let us know and we can add an evaluation flag.

Attachments: safelist_template.csv (CSV)

If netops prefers a short call to finalize the peering checklist I can jump on Wednesday afternoon — Marcus / Olga, pls confirm availability.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
